messages:
Jules Martinez: Heads-up: StratusWorks invoice SW-2026-12-211 for $11,320 landed without a PO and was posted to CLOUD-OPS instead of ENG-Platform. PDF: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/2026/stratus-sw-211.pdf :eyes:

invoices-bot: New invoice uploaded: StratusWorks SW-2026-12-211, vendor_id=SW-211, amount $11,320. No PO detected. Recommended action: HOLD. AP ticket AP-9178 created.

Hannah Lee: This was for the spike we ran on the vector indexing cluster on Dec 18. We had a handshake email but no PO since it was a short trial. Cost center should be ENG-PLATFORM (GL 5602).

Evan Brooks: Oof. Vendor billing to wrong GL and no PO. Please request corrected invoice referencing an active PO or a credit memo. Procurement, any open PO that can cover this?

Procurement-bot: Scanning... Potential match: PO-ENG-2026-099 exists for StratusWorks but its effective dates are Dec 22-31. Suggest vendor reissue referencing PO-ENG-2026-099 with corrected dates or issue credit and re-bill. If vendor refuses, Procurement recommends retro PO `PO-ENG-RETRO-2026-030` only with VP Eng approval.

Jules Martinez: I'll message the vendor now: "Per Redwood policy, invoices must reference a valid PO. Please reissue SW-2026-12-211 referencing PO-ENG-2026-099 or provide a credit memo so you can rebill. Also correct the GL to ENG-PLATFORM (GL 5602)."

invoices-bot: AP-9178 update: vendor_contacted. Vendor claims invoice was auto-generated by their meter and they cannot reissue the same invoice number. They offered a credit memo but only for $3,200. Added note: escalate to finance-approvals if partial credit unacceptable.

Hannah Lee: Partial credit won't fly unless we can reconcile meter lines. Could Procurement get us the raw job IDs to cross-check? I can attach logs: s3://redwood-logs/indexing/spikes/2026-12/12-18-jobs.csv

Evan Brooks: Attach those logs to AP-9178. If vendor meter double-counted any job IDs we can argue for full credit. If not, we may accept partial credit and create retro PO, but that needs VP sign-off.

Procurement-bot: Negotiation note: Ask vendor for line-item breakdown and UUID list for billed jobs. If vendor provides clear duplication, request full credit. If vendor insists on partial credit, route AP-9178 to Anika for approval of retro PO.

Jules Martinez: Sent follow-up: "Please provide line-item meter IDs and timestamps. If duplicates are present, issue full credit. Otherwise please issue credit memo and we will consider rebilling to PO-ENG-2026-099." Vendor replied attaching CSV: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/2026/stratus-meter-sw-211.csv

Hannah Lee: Looking at the meter CSV: I see three job IDs duplicated across two meter records each. Looks like they billed duplicates. I'll annotate and upload: s3://redwood-logs/indexing/spikes/2026-12/12-18-dedup-analysis.csv and attach to AP-9178.

invoices-bot: AP-9178 update: vendor_provided_meter_logs. Added vendor note: "We see duplicates on our side too, issuing adjusted credit of $8,500 and new invoice will be submitted referencing PO-ENG-2026-099." Vendor asks for payment on new invoice within 5 business days.

Evan Brooks: That's reasonable. If vendor issues new invoice referencing PO-ENG-2026-099 we can process. Procurement, confirm PO has capacity and that approver routing goes to VP Eng.

Procurement-bot: Confirmed PO-ENG-2026-099 has available balance $25,000 and is mapped to ENG-Platform. Approver rule: amounts > $5k route to VP Eng. invoices-bot: re-route will occur when vendor references PO-ENG-2026-099.

Jules Martinez: Great. I'll ask vendor to send the reissued invoice and credit memo. Also requested they void SW-2026-12-211 to avoid duplicate payments.

invoices-bot: AP-9178 note: vendor_promised_credit_and_reissue. Timeline: vendor will upload credit memo and new invoice within 3 business days. If no docs in 5 business days, escalate to Legal.

Hannah Lee: I'll keep the logs attached and mark invoice as disputed. Once AP confirms new invoice linked to PO-ENG-2026-099 and approver routing to Anika is set, we can release payment.

Evan Brooks: Also please add a vendor master update: billing_contact should be ap-eng@stratusworks.com and approver_group=EngFinance to avoid wrong routing in the future. Procurement, can you open a vendor change request?

Procurement-bot: Opening vendor master change PR-4599 to update billing contact and approver group. Note added to vendor record: "Require PO reference for all invoices; map to ENG-Platform; approver VP Eng for >$5k."

Jules Martinez: Thanks all. Leaving this thread open until AP confirms credit memo + reissue received and payment released. :white_check_mark:
